title: Facility Networks, Automation & Logistics Integration
objective: Implement built-facility network adapters over MERA interfaces for setting-defined utilities, sensor/controller condition-to-authorized-operation bindings, inventory/storage/conveyance/routing interfaces, definition-backed throughput/capacity/priority projections, production-facility capability bindings to ICF/MIB-12/Economy, PCA-12 analysis adapters, and safe stop/failure/recovery explanations without creating a generic engineering graph, automation language, inventory ledger, or production recipe engine.
acceptance: Power, fluid, air, heat, data, magic and other setting-defined facility networks bind to explicit MERA/owner interfaces rather than a second engineering graph.
Sensor/controller automation is bounded condition-to-authorized-owner-operation orchestration; it cannot become unrestricted scripting or autonomous GM/human decision authority.
Storage, conveyance, routing and Inventory interfaces preserve canonical Asset/Inventory identity and versions without a second inventory ledger.
Throughput, capacity and priority are projected only when accepted definitions supply the needed facts; unsupported values remain unresolved.
Production facilities bind to accepted ICF/MIB-12/Economy recipes and operations without copying recipe, production or economy truth.
PCA-12/Packet-08 flow, capacity and cycle analysis remains noncanonical analysis over declared topology.
Safe stop, failure and recovery preserve owner versions/history and provide semantic accessible explanations.
boundaries: MBES-01, MBES-03 and MBES-05 remain sealed predecessors.
MERA retains generic engineering topology, interface, dependency, failure and repair authority.
GPR and canonical owner operations retain execution authority.
Inventory/Asset retains live storage/item identity and mutation truth.
ICF and MIB-12 retain production/crafting/transformation definitions and transactions; MIB-13/Economy retains economic truth.
MBES-08 creates no generic automation language, engineering graph, inventory ledger, recipe engine, economy ledger or provenance ledger.
MBES-12 and later MBES tranches remain unauthorized until canonical MBES-08 closeout.
next_action: Establish causal RED for MBES-08 through the public facility-network/automation/logistics seam, then implement only the bounded owner-backed adapters required by the reduced family contract.

last_material_progress.evidence: Owner Continue governed-started MBES-08 from canonical selected_not_started state.
